name: 大型股vs小型股領導

hypotheses.H1_LARGE_CAP_LEADERSHIP: Large-cap leadership can reflect concentrated institutional/passive flow, global bellwether exposure, liquidity preference or index-weight transmission.
hypotheses.H2_SMALL_CAP_DIFFUSION: Small-cap leadership can reflect risk appetite, domestic liquidity, thematic diffusion or later-cycle broadening.
hypotheses.H3_NO_UNIVERSAL_SIZE_SIGN: Neither large-cap nor small-cap leadership has a permanent bullish sign; size effects and leadership can reverse by regime and sample.
hypotheses.H4_INDEX_CONCENTRATION_CONFOUND: Cap-weighted index strength can look like broad market leadership when only a few mega-caps drive returns.
hypotheses.H5_MICROSTRUCTURE_CONFOUND: Observed size leadership can be contaminated by liquidity, tick-size, spread, price-limit and turnover differences rather than information leadership.

falsification: leadership disappears after market/sector beta and industry-mix controls
result is driven by one mega-cap or one theme

apparent small-cap premium disappears after liquidity/transaction-cost controls

taiwanEvidenceSummary: Historical Taiwan size-anomaly literature is mixed rather than universally small-cap positive.

Taiwan microstructure research shows transaction-cost/liquidity behavior varies with price/trading activity and tick-size structure, so size leadership cannot be interpreted without execution/liquidity controls.
Taiwan derivative-expiry evidence shows disproportionate volume/volatility effects can concentrate in high-weight index stocks, creating a large-cap leadership confound.

redundancyBoundary.D09_10: Within-sector concentration; not the same as cross-size leadership.
redundancyBoundary.D05: Institutional/passive-flow ownership is a control/dependency, not D09-08 progress.
redundancyBoundary.D14: Execution cost and liquidity are controls/dependencies, not D09-08 progress.
redundancyBoundary.D13: Global bellwether transmission is a dependency when mega-caps dominate.

next: BR-033 freeze a prospective Taiwan size-bucket receipt with decision-date market cap, free-float/index membership, liquidity and sector-mix controls; then accumulate independent dates before any large-vs-small leadership outcome test.
